# data.docker_container_top

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Lists the processes running in a container, like `docker container top`. `top.titles` holds the column names and `top.processes` one row per process; the container must be running.
